title: Probing Criticality Using GMM-Based Potentials
summary: Spin models with a given symmetry are easier to sample than scalar theories with the same symmetry on a lattice, as the constrained nature of spin variables enables cheap heat-bath updates. However, this constraint suppresses radial fluctuations, and consequently, spin models cannot be used to study the phenomena of spontaneous symmetry breaking, such as the Higgs phenomenon. To address this, we propose a class of scalar potentials based on Gaussian Mixture Models (GMMs) that are as easy to sample as spin models with a given symmetry.
